_note: AuthZEN 1.0 section 9 (PDP metadata). 9.2 and 9.2.1: the document is served at GET /.well-known/authzen-configuration; 9.2.2: 200 with Content-Type application/json. 9.1.1: policy_decision_point and access_evaluation_endpoint (REQUIRED) and access_evaluations_endpoint; the search_subject_endpoint, search_action_endpoint and search_resource_endpoint parameters are absent because Attenuo does not serve the Search APIs (an absent parameter means the PDP does not support that API), and capabilities and signed_metadata (9.1.2, 9.1.3) are not published. The exact comparison also proves nothing else is in the document. The document is public metadata: step 0 sends no credential, and step 1 sends a credential that is not a valid token and still gets the same document, because discovery does not look at Authorization.
